title: Vyaktitv: A Multimodal Peer-to-Peer Hindi Conversations based Dataset for Personality Assessment
reasoning: The paper uses ethical questions, such as views on euthanasia and animal cloning, as conversation prompts for data collection (Table II). Additionally, it gathers data on whether participants are 'religious/culturally inclined' as a socio-demographic feature (Table III). The analysis connects responses and socio-demographic factors to personality traits, thus incorporating an evaluation of ethical and religious dimensions.
